title: Best Bengals & Commanders Cards: Joe Burrow, Ja’Marr Chase & Jayden Daniels Values
summary: Discover the most valuable Joe Burrow, Ja’Marr Chase, and Jayden Daniels cards on Courtyard. Explore top pack grails, recent marketplace sales, and card values.
body_markdown:
[Joe Burrow](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Joe%20Burrow&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) is dominating the 2026 NFL season, which makes it no surprise that his cards dominate the Bengals card market on Courtyard, too.


As Joe Brr sits atop[the NFL MVP ladder](https://www.espn.com/espn/betting/story/_/id/48476156/2026-nfl-awards-betting-odds-mvp-rookie-year-offensive-defensive-player-coach) , cards featuring the Cincinnati Bengals quarterback occupy all ten of the highest-value Bengals cards in[Courtyard’s football packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) , led by a Flawless rookie patch autograph valued at $80,000. When looking at what football card collectors on Courtyard are buying from the peer-to-peer marketplace, the story is similar: Burrow and his longtime WR1,[Ja’Marr Chase](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Ja%27Marr%20Chase&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , make up nine of the 10 highest sales of Bengals cards.


The Bengals’ high-flying offense inspired us to throw our own deep ball.


Here are the best Bengals cards in Courtyard packs, sales data for Bengals cards on Courtyard’s peer-to-peer marketplace, and how Bengals cards stack up against their Monday Night Football counterparts,[Jayden Daniels](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jayden%20Daniels&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) and the Washington Commanders.


## **Top Joe Burrow & Bengals Cards in Courtyard Packs**


The Cincinnati Bengals have come a long way from their days as the lowly Bungles. These days, they’re one of the most fearsome teams in the AFC North, capable of hanging 50 on a team any given Sunday (...or Wednesday, Thursday, or Monday, given the league’s increasing slate of games each week).


That got us thinking: *What are the best Bengals players football card collectors can pull from Courtyard’s football packs?* Here are the five Bengals cards with the highest fair market value (FMV) currently available in Courtyard packs.


1. [Joe Burrow](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Joe%20Burrow&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **:** **2020 Panini Flawless Rookie Dual Patch Autographs Platinum Rookie Card #3 (BGS 9.5 GEM MINT) – FMV: $80,000**
2. **Joe Burrow: 2021 Panini Flawless Dual Diamond Memorabilia #DD3, Platinum 1/1, with**[Justin Herbert](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Justin%20Herbert&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **(PSA 10 GEM MINT) – FMV: $11,084**
3. **Joe Burrow: 2020 Panini Donruss Optic #151, Silver Circles Rookie Card (PSA 9 MINT) – FMV: $440**
4. **Joe Burrow: 2025 Panini Donruss Optic Uptown #12 (PSA 9 MINT) – FMV: $373**
5. **Joe Burrow: 2020 Panini Donruss Optic #151, Aqua Rookie Card (PSA 9 MINT) – FMV: $307**


Both Flawless rookie dual patches are the real deep threat here, although the auto takes the cake. Will Herbert be able to regain his past form and make the second card on the list even more appealing? Meanwhile, the last three are more approachable, with both of the Optic rookies among Burrow’s more coveted ‘true’ rookie cards.


## **Joe Burrow & Ja’Marr Chase Card Values: Recent Marketplace Sales**


The Bengals have been a problem for defenses around the NFL for years, but of the biggest sales of Bengals players on Courtyard’s peer-to-peer marketplace the biggest sale took place during the offseason.


- [Joe Burrow](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Joe%20Burrow&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **: 2025 Panini Prizm Prizmania #6 (PSA 10 GEM MINT), sold on August 18th for $1,645**
- [Ja'Marr Chase](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Ja%27Marr%20Chase&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **: 2021 Panini Donruss Optic Downtown Rookie Card #DT36 (PSA 10 GEM MINT), sold November 21st for $1,400**
- **Ja’Marr Chase; 2021 Panini Donruss Optic Downtown Rookie Card #DT36 BGS 9.5 GEM MINT, sold June 30th for $1,010**


[The Courtyard marketplace charges sellers 0% selling fees](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/is-courtyard-io-legit-heres-what-you-need-to-know) , and that’s reflected in great deals for buyers—and more take home pay for sellers. Of the three cards listed above, two sold for slightly less than their FMV, with sellers making up the difference with the 0% selling fees while buyers got their new grail at a great price.


It’s also worth noting the impact of on-field performance here; the first Chase card listed above came less than a week after he caught 11 of 14 targets for 231 yards in the Bengals 38-18 win over the division rival Pittsburgh Steelers. Perhaps that’s why Joe Burrow was the fifth most-searched football term on Courtyard between November 19th and November 22nd, the majority of Week 11 of the 2026 NFL season, as the MVP frontrunner continues to turn heads—and drive sales.


Oh, and don’t worry,[Tee Higgins](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Tee%20Higgins&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) fans: The prolific wideout was one of the top-10 sales of a Bengals card on Courtyard’s peer-to-peer marketplace—he just didn’t crack the top-three.

As is the case with Bengals cards, those chasing the Commanders will be hunting for their signalcaller:[Jayden Daniels](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jayden%20Daniels&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) .


1. **Jayden Daniels: 2024 Panini Prizm Prizmania #2 (PSA 10 GEM MINT) – FMV: $4,105**
2. **Jayden Daniels: 2024 Panini Absolute Kaboom! Horizontal #7 (PSA 9 MINT) – FMV: $784**
3. **Jayden Daniels: 2024 Panini Donruss Downtown! #16 (PSA 9 MINT), with two copies available – FMV: $489**


Daniels has had a solid 2026 season, even if the Commanders have underperformed. He’s turned things around since his injury-plagued 2025 season, but the Commanders will have a decision to make as his rookie scale contract nears its end.
